bullets.section: Research I’m shocked I didn’t come across sooner —
bullets.title: Cannabidiol Inhibits SARS-CoV-2 Replication and Promotes the Host Innate Immune Response
bullets.note: From the abstract: “Here we report that cannabidiol (CBD), a compound produced by the cannabis plant, inhibits SARS-CoV-2 infection. CBD and its metabolite, 7-OH-CBD, but not congeneric cannabinoids, potently block SARS-CoV-2 replication in lung epithelial cells. CBD acts after cellular infection, inhibiting viral gene expression and reversing many effects of SARS-CoV-2 on host gene transcription.”
